parameters.query: WITH next_run AS (SELECT r.run_id FROM gov.mission_runs r JOIN gov.missions m ON m.mission_id = r.mission_id WHERE r.status = 'queued' AND r.agent_id = '{{$json.agent_id_sql}}' AND m.approval_state = 'approved' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT 1), upd AS (UPDATE gov.mission_runs r SET status='running', phase='pull_assigned', nn=0, updated_at=now() FROM next_run n WHERE r.run_id = n.run_id RETURNING r.run_id, r.mission_id, r.branch, r.agent_id, r.status, r.phase, r.nn, r.total, r.report_ref, r.updated_at) SELECT run_id, mission_id, branch, agent_id, status, phase, nn, total, report_ref, to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') as updated_at_utc FROM upd;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status:'assigned', run_id:$json.run_id, mission_id:$json.mission_id, agent_id:$json.agent_id, branch:$json.branch, phase:$json.phase, nn:$json.nn, total:$json.total, updated_at_utc:$json.updated_at_utc } }}
